<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex019052026-07-0809-59-57" status="unreviewed"> de dag sel ba ni bu tas chos snga ma rnams gsungs pas dang por skyes pa thams cad 'chi ba shi ba dgra bcom pa gsum
               <lb n="5a2"/> ma gtogs pa thams cad skye ba len dogs par mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo' lasogs pa las gsungs pas rmongs pa dang po bsal la | de ltar skye shi thug pa med par byed dogs snra shes pas 'jigs pa dang skrag pa skyabs tshol ba'i blo skye la | de'i dus na skyabs gnas dken mchog gyi che ba la rmongs pa bsal
               <lb n="5a3"/> nas snying gi pad ma kha 'byed pa yang sangs rgyas kyi gsung kho na te | des tshe 'di'i 'tshe ba las gtsor byin blabs kyis skyeb pa dang | ngan song dang theg pa dman pa'i bar las gtsor lung gis ji ltar skyeb pa la rmongs pa'i mun pa sel cing snying gi pad ma kha 'byed pa las | bu ta'i che ba'i yon tan
               <lb n="5a4"/> yang bhu 1 nyid dang sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gsungs pa 'dra ba phyis kyi slob dpon kun gyis ye mi mkhyen <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3827">dge' bshes ston pa</rs> gsung || || </seg></TEI>
